description_en: This API maps to the frontend function location: Quality Inspection Rule Configuration - Create & Update. The Apsara Stack URL is: ip:port/api/client/UpdateRuleById.json
description_zh: 对应前端功能位置：质检规则配置-新建&更新。专有云URL：ip:port/api/client/UpdateRuleById.json
kebab_example: aliyun qualitycheck update-rule-by-id --rule-id 1 --json-str-for-rule '{}' --return-related-schemes false --is-copy false --base-me-agent-id 1 --api-version 2019-01-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateRuleById

parameters.help_en: Rule ID. Not required when creating, required when modifying
parameters.help_zh: 规则ID。新增时不需要提供，修改时需要提供
parameters.name: rule_id

parameters.help_en: For more information about the format of JsonStrForlRule, see `Rule object description` (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/453053.html)
parameters.help_zh: JsonStrForlRule具体参考文档《`规则对象说明` (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/453053.html)》
parameters.name: json_str_for_rule

parameters.help_en: Returns the IDs and names of quality inspection schemes associated with this rule
parameters.help_zh: 返回和该规则有关联的质检方案ID名称
parameters.name: return_related_schemes

parameters.help_en: Whether to copy. Setting to true is equivalent to copying the rule
parameters.help_zh: 是否复制。为true是等效于复制规则
parameters.name: is_copy
